visual_thesis: A reusable reconciliation Skill proposes cited matches and flags exceptions while posting stays under authorized review. At phone scale see source pairing and sign-off boundary; full size reveals period rules, duplicates, missing records and uncertainty.
mechanism_metaphor: A top-down forensic reconciliation spread with two broad intersecting record rails, not a book or dashboard. Left rail is a bank export with one amount-shaped geometric specimen and its source-row notch. Upper rail is the same-period ledger with matching notches, a separate duplicate pair and a missing-record gap. All record faces are blank, no simulated writing or numbers. A narrow alignment bridge binds company, period and rules through three differently shaped scope tabs. In the center, paired cited matches are connected by headless witness ties; unmatched and duplicate pieces sit in a visibly separate exception channel. A large graphite review boundary at right interrupts the path before a blank posting specimen. Exactly two arrowheads: authorized record alignment port to proposed-match port, then proposed-match port to review-boundary inlet. No arrow beyond review and no automated posting. A reusable Skill template is folded below the alignment bridge, linked by a headless association line rather than an automatic learning loop. Fourteen parts: bank source, source-row notch, ledger source, matched pair, scope bridge, company tab, period tab, rule tab, duplicate pair, missing gap, uncertainty flag, exception channel, reviewer boundary and reusable template. Detached no-posting caveat below-right. No money symbols, fake totals, success marks, locks, people or ledger prose.
